title: Flashing warning lamp
brief: Make a warning lamp flash while a fault is active.
requirements: Fault (I0.0) is ON while a machine fault exists. Warning Lamp (Q0.0) provides a flashing visual warning.
When Fault (I0.0) is OFF, Warning Lamp (Q0.0) must be OFF.
When Fault first switches ON, immediately begin with Warning Lamp (Q0.0) ON for approximately 1 second, followed by OFF for approximately 1 second.
Continue alternating these ON and OFF phases while Fault (I0.0) remains ON.
If Fault switches OFF, extinguish Warning Lamp immediately and reset the flashing cycle. A new fault must begin with the ON phase. A 100 ms simulated-scan tolerance is allowed.
objective: Build a repeating timer feedback circuit.
hints: Use two TON blocks to alternate between timing the ON and OFF phases.
Enable the first timer with Fault AND NOT second timer Q; enable the second with Fault AND first timer Q. Lamp = Fault AND NOT first timer Q.
